full_judgment: 3. That 2nd Party-opposite parties No. 6-14 filed written statement in the case. Their case was that the proceeding lands were purchased in auction sale by the superior landlord who took the land in his khas possession and subsequently he gave settlement of 13.13 acres of land of R.S. Khatian 579 to Sultan Ahmed, 5.00 acres to Badiur Rahman, 4.00 acres to Atar Ali and 23.43 acres to Fazar Ali from RS. Khatian No. 578, 580,581 and 582. The Second Party No. 1 and 2 claimed peaceful possession of 13.43 acres of land out of M.RR. Khatian No.577 and Second Party No. 3 was in possession of 4.00 acres from the same Khatian while other co-sharers were in possession of the remaining land.
